# Semantic Comment Patterns — Never Touch

Comments that tooling reads. Deleting or rewording any of these changes program, build, lint, or IDE behavior. Patterns are representative, not exhaustive — an unrecognized comment shaped like a machine directive (`tool:action`, short and rigidly formatted) gets the same treatment.

## Cross-language

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Shebangs | `#!/usr/bin/env ...` (first line) |
| Editor modelines | `# vim:`, `// vim:`, `-*- mode: ... -*-` |
| IDE structure markers | `#region` / `#endregion`, `// MARK:` (Xcode) |
| License / copyright headers | SPDX tags (`SPDX-License-Identifier:`), copyright blocks at file top |
| Generated-file markers | "do not edit", "generated by", `@generated` — the whole file is out of scope |
| Secret scanners | `# pragma: allowlist secret` (detect-secrets), `# gitleaks:allow` |
| Spell checkers | `# codespell:ignore`, `cspell:disable` / `cspell:ignore` |
| Coverage | `LCOV_EXCL_LINE`, `LCOV_EXCL_START/STOP` |
| Renovate/dependency bots | `# renovate:` annotations |

## Python

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Lint / type suppressions | `# noqa`, `# type: ignore[...]`, `# mypy:`, `# pyright: ignore`, `# ruff: noqa`, `# pylint: disable/enable`, `# nosec` (bandit) |
| Coverage | `# pragma: no cover`, `# pragma: no branch` |
| Formatters | `# fmt: off/on/skip`, `# yapf: disable/enable`, `# isort: skip/off/on` |
| Encoding | `# -*- coding: ... -*-` (first two lines) |
| Doctests | `>>>` examples inside docstrings — executable under `doctest`/pytest |

## JavaScript / TypeScript

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Lint suppressions | `// eslint-disable-next-line`, `/* eslint-disable */`, `// biome-ignore`, `/* jshint */` |
| Type checker | `// @ts-ignore`, `// @ts-expect-error`, `// @ts-nocheck`, `// @ts-check`, `// @flow` |
| Formatters | `// prettier-ignore` |
| Coverage | `/* istanbul ignore ... */`, `/* c8 ignore ... */`, `/* v8 ignore ... */` |
| Compiler / bundler | `/// <reference ... />` triple-slash directives, webpack magic comments (`/* webpackChunkName: ... */`), `//# sourceMappingURL=`, `"use strict"`-adjacent pragma comments |
| Docs | JSDoc `/** ... */` — types feed IDEs and `tsc` checkJs; condense prose, keep tags |

## Go

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Compiler directives | any `//go:` comment — `//go:build`, `//go:generate`, `//go:embed`, `//go:noinline`, `//go:linkname`, legacy `// +build` |
| Lint suppressions | `//nolint:...`, `//lint:ignore` |
| Docs | godoc comment on an exported symbol is a lint-enforced convention — condense prose, never delete |
| Cgo | comment block immediately above `import "C"` is compiled code |

## Rust

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Docs | `///` and `//!` doc comments feed rustdoc; embedded code blocks run as doctests under `cargo test` |

## Ruby

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Magic comments | `# frozen_string_literal: true`, `# encoding:`, `# warn_indent:` (file top) |
| Lint suppressions | `# rubocop:disable/enable/todo`, `# standard:disable`, `# steep:ignore` |
| Type annotations | `# sorbet:`, `# typed:`, RBS inline annotations |

## Shell

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Lint suppressions | `# shellcheck disable=...`, `# shellcheck source=...`, `# shellcheck shell=...` |

## C / C++ / Objective-C

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Lint suppressions | `// NOLINT`, `// NOLINTNEXTLINE`, `// NOLINTBEGIN/END`, `// cppcheck-suppress` |
| Compiler hints | `/* FALLTHRU */` / `// fall through` (suppresses `-Wimplicit-fallthrough`) |
| Formatters | `// clang-format off/on` |

## Java / Kotlin

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Lint suppressions | `// noinspection` (IntelliJ), `// CHECKSTYLE:OFF/ON`, `//NOSONAR`, `@SuppressWarnings` in Javadoc position |
| Docs | Javadoc / KDoc on public API — condense prose, keep tags |

## C #

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Docs | XML doc comments (`/// <summary>`) feed IntelliSense and DocFX — condense prose, keep tags |
| Lint suppressions | `// ReSharper disable ...` |

## PHP

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Static analysis | `/** @var ... */`, `@param`/`@return` phpdoc consumed by PHPStan/Psalm, `// @phpstan-ignore-line`, `/** @psalm-suppress ... */` |

## Swift

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Lint suppressions | `// swiftlint:disable/enable` |
| IDE markers | `// MARK:`, `// TODO:`/`// FIXME:` (surfaced by Xcode) |

## SQL

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Optimizer hints | `/*+ ... */` (Oracle, MySQL, Spanner) — comments that change query plans |
| Lint suppressions | `-- noqa` (sqlfluff) |

## Infra / config

| Category | Patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Dockerfile | `# syntax=`, `# escape=`, `# check=` parser directives (file top), `# hadolint ignore=` |
| Terraform / HCL | `# tflint-ignore:`, `#ts:skip`, `# checkov:skip=`, `# trivy:ignore` |
| YAML | `# yamllint disable`, `# noqa` (ansible-lint), `# yaml-language-server: $schema=`, `# @schema` annotations (helm) |
| Kubernetes / CI | `# kics-scan ignore`, `# snyk:ignore`, `# nosemgrep` |
